description: Angular component 'NoteDetailComponent' that displays details of a note, providing options to edit, delete, and navigate back.

classes.name: NoteDetailComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for displaying and editing note details.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called upon component initialization.

methods.name: enableEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the note.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Emits the updated note and disables editing.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Emits an event to delete the current note.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Emits an event to navigate back.
